answer: Think of onboarding as a wharf where each new agent must show which account paid its entry fee. Rule: one funding source may sponsor at most 2 identities per epoch, and rewards for identities sharing a source are pooled and split, not added. A sybil voyage then needs a fresh funded account for every extra pair of fakes, so cost rises linearly while each fake earns less. Weakness: attackers can wander through mixers or many small accounts, so provenance tracing should back up other signals.
